home.title: The answer stays on the page you were given.
home.body: Ask in English or Kinyarwanda. The tutor works from your school curriculum and names the page.
home.previewAnswer: Subtract 5 from both sides, then divide by 3. The unknown is 5.
home.featureCiteBody: Factual replies name the booklet and the page they came from.
home.featureHintBody: Students can climb a hint ladder before the full answer is shown.
home.featureLanguageBody: The same explanation can be asked for again in either language.
home.step1Body: A school code, a username, and a password. Students do not need an email address.
home.step2Body: Retrieval uses the booklets your school ingested.
home.step3Body: Open the citation beside the reply and check the page yourself.

gate.title: Sign in to continue
gate.body: Lessons, the library, and class transcripts open after you sign in with your school.

desk.title: Your desk
desk.studentBody: Continue a lesson, open a booklet, or take the next step in a sequence.
desk.teacherBody: Open a class and read a transcript when the school allows it.
desk.adminBody: Ingest a booklet, review accounts, and choose the model.
desk.empty: No lesson yet. Start one when the chapter is in front of you.

login.title: Sign in
login.body: Use the school code and username you were given.
login.failed: The school, username, or password is incorrect.

learn.title: Lessons
learn.body: Each lesson keeps its own thread, hints, and cited replies.
learn.emptyBody: Name the topic and ask from the chapter you were given.
learn.modalBody: Name it after the topic. The first question comes once you are inside.
learn.name: Lesson name

chat.sourcesBody: These pages were retrieved for the latest reply.
chat.empty: Ask a question from the chapter you were given. The reply will cite the page.
chat.noSources: This reply has no page citation.

chapters.title: Library
chapters.body: Booklets the school has ingested. A ready file can be used in a lesson.
chapters.emptyBody: An administrator can ingest a PDF from the school page.

sequences.title: Sequences
sequences.body: Guided steps. One prompt at a time, then you move on.

teacher.title: Classes
teacher.body: Choose a class, then open a student transcript.
teacher.noStudents: This class has no students yet.
teacher.transcriptsOff: This school has not allowed teachers to read transcripts.
teacher.transcriptBody: Messages from this student, in the order they were sent.

admin.title: School
admin.body: Curriculum files, the reply model, and accounts.
admin.uploadBody: The file is stored with the school and prepared for retrieval.
admin.providerBody: Choose who writes the replies. Retrieval still uses your booklets.
admin.emptyDocuments: No file has been ingested yet.
admin.name: Name

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: The name and language shown on your lessons, and the password for this account.
settings.name: Display name
settings.changeBody: At least 10 characters, and the password must not contain your username.
